field_changes.old: Tweaking your training plan just got smarter — delete, swap, or add an exercise and a suggestion prompt appears right away, so you can dial in your preferences on the spot instead of waiting for the post-workout nudge. Weight predictions now refresh every time you open the app, keeping recommendations fresh based on your latest logs and equipment. Plus snappier exercise animation loading throughout.
field_changes.new: Exercise history and charts are now one page — tap any point on the chart to instantly see that day's logs. Deload weeks in your Adaptive Plan now correctly lighten your working weight. Post-workout summaries and share cards got a fresh redesign, with cardio counting toward your muscle body map. Private newsfeed posts now show a clear privacy label, and we squashed a handful of bugs along the way.
